description: One-call overview of the whole dataset: Bitcoin and Ethereum SMM scores and zones, BTC price (AUD/USD), Altcoin Season Index, the latest US spot Bitcoin ETF daily flow, ASX Bitcoin ETF assets and the Crypto Fear & Greed Index (the only tool that returns Fear & Greed). Use this for broad questions like 'how is the crypto market looking' or when the user wants several readings at once; call the specific tool instead when the user needs history, per-fund detail or tier breakdowns. Each line carries its own date and source page.
name: get_market_snapshot
title: Crypto market-cycle snapshot
